styles.name: penrose-p3
styles.description: Penrose P3 rhombus tiling: Robinson-triangle deflation reveals fat (72°) and thin (36°) rhombi generation by generation as progress rises; the whole pattern rotates slowly with time

styles.name: penrose-p2
styles.description: Penrose P2 kite & dart tiling: golden-triangle / golden-gnomon subdivision reveals the kite-and-dart mosaic generation by generation; time animates a gentle shimmer across revealed tiles

styles.name: sun-pattern
styles.description: Penrose sun: five kites sharing the central vertex, then the surrounding dart ring, then outer kite rings — each concentric generation appears as progress rises, pulsing gently with time

styles.name: girih-tiles
styles.description: Islamic girih tile strapwork: a central 10-gon surrounded by pentagons and bowties; interior strap lines reveal with progress, the whole pattern rotating with time like a medieval mosque decoration

styles.name: ammann-bars
styles.description: Ammann bars: the five quasiperiodic stripe families that decorate every Penrose P3 rhombus tiling, with long-L and short-S spacings in ratio PHI; families reveal one by one as progress rises

styles.name: debruijn-pentagrid
styles.description: de Bruijn pentagrid: five families of quasiperiodic parallel lines at 72° intervals whose dual gives a Penrose tiling; the grid weaves in with progress and the dual rhombus vertices twinkle with time

styles.name: decagon-fractal
styles.description: Decagon fractal: a central 10-gon filled with rings of smaller 10-gons at each recursion level, forming a self-similar quasicrystalline snowflake that unfolds as progress rises

styles.name: quasicrystal-diffraction
styles.description: Quasicrystal interference: sum of 5 plane waves at 72° intervals produces a 10-fold diffraction pattern; a moving threshold cuts through the field as progress rises, the whole pattern rotating slowly with time

styles.name: pinwheel-tiling
styles.description: Pinwheel tiling: a 1:2 right triangle substitutes into 5 smaller copies at irrational rotations, filling the plane with triangles at every angle; deflation generations bloom outward as progress rises

styles.name: truchet-quasi
styles.description: Truchet-quasi: quarter-circle arcs placed in the fat and thin rhombi of a Penrose-like quasiperiodic lattice; orientation is deterministically varied so the arc flow never repeats, revealed tile by tile with progress
